concepts.def: For instantaneous rate on a curve

walkthroughs.body_html:
Mean rate = total change / total time.

Instantaneous rate = gradient of tangent at a point.

Energy in = bonds broken. Energy out = bonds made.

Overall = bonds broken - bonds made.

If negative -> exothermic.

Q = m x c x delta T.

For 100 g water heated by 20 C: Q = 100 x 4.2 x 20 = 8400 J.
